titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Ten Commandments and the Forbidden Unions (ch. 42)
part: ch. 42 — The Ten Commandments and the Forbidden Unions
about: The commandments of Exodus 20 are recited in the voice of God, followed by the laws of forbidden sexual unions from Leviticus 18, worked through relative by relative, and a closing charge to sanctify body and soul to the Lord, ending in praise.

sentences.t: ፵፪ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ፲ ፡ ቃላት ።
sentences.l: 42. Concerning 10 words.
sentences.i: Chapter 42: Concerning the Ten Words
sentences.n: Chapter heading. በእንተ 'concerning' takes the plural ቃላት, 'words' (ቃል 'word, utterance' with the external plural -at). The numeral ፲ is 10 (Ethiopic numerals are signs of their own, written between two bars), here the Ten Commandments, called 'the ten words' as in Exodus 20 and Deuteronomy 5. The chapter joins that Decalogue to the laws of forbidden sexual unions in Leviticus 18, and ends in praise.

sentences.t: ወስምዑ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ዘተአዘዘ ፡ እምእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ትዕቀቡ ፡ ኪያሁ ።
sentences.l: And-hear-(you) Israel that-which-was-commanded from-God, that you-keep him/it.
sentences.i: And hear, Israel, what was commanded by God, that you keep it.
sentences.n: ስምዑ is the 2mp imperative of ሰምዐ 'hear' with ወ- 'and' in front; እስራኤል is the vocative. ዘተአዘዘ is ዘ- 'that which, the thing that' (the relative marker, which will recur constantly) + ተአዘዘ, 3ms perfect of the passive-reflexive stem of አዘዘ 'command': 'was commanded'. እም- 'from' here means 'by'. ከመ introduces a purpose or content clause and takes the subjunctive: ትዕቀቡ is the 2mp subjunctive of ዐቀበ 'keep, guard'. ኪያሁ is the independent object pronoun (accusative base ኪያ- + -ሁ), 'him' or 'it'; it points back to 'what was commanded', so 'it' (it could be 'him', God (?)).

sentences.t: ወይቤ ፡ አነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ዘአውፃእኩከ ፡ እምነ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ቅኔ ፤
sentences.l: And-said: I he God, your-God, who-I-brought-out-you from land-of Egypt and-from house-of servitude;
sentences.i: And he said: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and out of the house of servitude;
sentences.n: Exodus 20:2. ይቤ 'he said' is the suppletive perfect of ብህለ (no ordinary perfect of ብህለ is used), and the speaker is God. አነ ውእቱ is 'I, he', the pronoun doing the work of 'am'. እግዚኣብሔር is the divine name: 'God' in l (the house rendering), 'the Lord' in i while God himself speaks in scriptural quotation. The suffix -ከ 'your (2ms)' on አምላክከ will recur on almost every noun in this chapter. ዘአውፃእኩከ is ዘ- 'who' + አውፃእኩ, the 1cs perfect of the causative of ወፅአ 'go out' ('I caused to go out, I brought out'), + -ከ 'you'; the verb agrees with 'I' even after ዘ. ምድረ ግብጽ and ቤተ ቅኔ are construct chains ('land-of Egypt', 'house-of ቅኔ'); ቅኔ here I take as 'service, servitude' (?), the same word as in ግብረ ቅኔ in sentence 9; hence 'house of servitude' (a noun of forced service; it can also mean 'poetry', which does not fit).

sentences.t: ወኢይኩን ፡ ባዕደ ፡ አማልክተ ፡ ዘእንበሌየ ፡ ወኢትግበር ፡ አምላከ ፡ ዘግልፎ ፡ ወኢበኵሉ ፡ አምሳል ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ዘላዕሉ ፡ ወኢበኵሉ ፡ ዘበ ፡ ምድር ፡ በታሕቱ ፡ ወኢዘውስተ ፡ ማይ ፡ ዘመትሕተ ፡ ምድር ፤
sentences.l: And-not-let-be other gods except-me, and-not-you-make a-god of-carving(?), and-not in-any likeness that-in heaven that-above, and-not in-any that-on earth below, and-not that-in water that-under earth;
sentences.i: Let there be no other gods besides me. Do not make a carved god, nor any likeness of what is in heaven above, or on the earth below, or in the water under the earth;
sentences.n: Exodus 20:3-4. A pattern to learn now: ኢ- before a 2nd-person jussive is a prohibition ('do not ...'), and ወኢ- repeats it for each item ('and not ... nor ...'). ወኢይኩን is ወ- + ኢ- + the 3ms jussive of ኮነ 'be': 'let there not be'. ባዕደ is the accusative of ባዕድ 'other, foreign', used with a plural noun አማልክተ 'gods' (plural of አምላክ, accusative -ä). The text has no ለከ 'to you' after ኢይኩን, which the sense wants (compare ይኩንከ in a later sentence); I take it as an elliptical or slipped reading (?). ዘእንበሌየ is ዘእንበለ 'except, apart from' + -የ 'me'. ኢትግበር is the 2ms jussive of ገብረ 'make, do'. ዘግልፎ is uncertain (?): I take ግልፎ as a noun 'carving, carved thing' (cf. ገለፈ 'carve'), with ዘ 'of', so 'a god of carving', i.e. a carved idol; it could also be a verb form ('which is carved'). ኢበኵሉ አምሳል is 'in any likeness', ኵሉ 'all, any'. ዘውስተ is ዘ + ውስተ 'that (is) in'; ዘላዕሉ 'that (is) above'; በታሕቱ 'below'; ዘመትሕተ 'that (is) under'. The printed ዘበ ፡ ምድር is ዘ + በ 'that (is) on' with the preposition spaced off the noun, probably the edition's spacing.

sentences.t: ወኢትስግድ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ወኢታምልኮሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-not-you-bow to-them, and-not-you-worship-them;
sentences.i: Do not bow down to them, and do not worship them;
sentences.n: Exodus 20:5. ኢትስግድ is the 2ms jussive of ሰገደ 'bow down', ሎሙ is 'to them' (ለ- + -ሙ 3mp). ኢታምልኮሙ is the 2ms jussive of አምለከ, a verb made from አምላክ 'God' (so 'treat as God, worship'), with -ሙ 'them' as object.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ አነ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ አምላክ ፡ ቀናኢ ፡ ዘእትፈደይ ፡ ኀጢአተ ፡ ወላዲ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ውሉድ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሣልስ ፡ ወራብዕ ፡ ትውልድ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይጸልኡኒ ፤
sentences.l: For I God your-God, a-God jealous, who-I-repay sin-of parent upon children until third and-fourth generation, to-those who-hate-me;
sentences.i: For I am the Lord your God, a jealous God, I who repay the sin of the parent upon the children, as far as the third and fourth generation, for those who hate me;
sentences.n: Exodus 20:5, continued. እስመ 'for, because' opens a reason. ቀናኢ 'jealous, zealous' is a participial adjective of ቀነአ. ዘእትፈደይ is ዘ- + እትፈደይ, 1cs imperfect of ፈደየ 'repay' (the ት after the person-prefix is what a ተ-stem ተፈደየ gives, 'I take repayment', where plain ፈደየ would give እፌድይ; I read it so (?)): in Geʿez a relative clause keeps the person of its antecedent ('God ... who I repay'). ኀጢአተ ወላዲ 'sin-of begetter' is a construct chain (ወላዲ, active participle of ወለደ 'beget': 'parent, father'); ላዕለ ውሉድ 'upon children' (ውሉድ the plural of ወልድ). እስከ 'until'. ሣልስ 'third' and ራብዕ 'fourth' are ordinals left in the masculine singular before ትውልድ 'generation'. ለእለ is ለ- 'to, of' + እለ 'those who' (the plural relative); ይጸልኡኒ is the 3mp imperfect of ጸልአ 'hate' + -ኒ 'me'.

sentences.t: ወእገብር ፡ ምሕረተ ፡ እስከ ፡ ፼ ፡ ትውልድ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ያፈቅሩኒ ፡ ወየዐቅቡ ፡ ትእዛዝየ ።
sentences.l: And-I-do mercy until 10,000 generation to-those who-love-me and-keep my-commandment.
sentences.i: and I show mercy, as far as ten thousand generations, to those who love me and keep my commandment.
sentences.n: Exodus 20:6. ወእገብር is ወ- + the 1cs imperfect of ገብረ 'do, make', with ምሕረተ, the accusative of ምሕረት 'mercy'. The numeral ፼ is 10,000 in Ethiopic numerals; Exodus has a thousand where this text has ten thousand, so the promise is stated even more widely than the threat above. ያፈቅሩኒ is the 3mp imperfect of አፍቀረ 'love' + -ኒ 'me'; ወየዐቅቡ is 'and they keep' (3mp imperfect of ዐቀበ, the verb of the first sentence). ትእዛዝየ 'my commandment' is ትእዛዝ (from አዘዘ, the verb 'command' above) + -የ 'my'; singular as written (it may be collective, 'commandments'), so I keep the singular in i.

sentences.t: ወኢትምሐል ፡ ስመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ በሐሰት ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢያነጽሕ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለዘ ፡ ይምሕል ፡ ስሞ ፡ በሐሰት ።
sentences.l: And-not-you-swear name-of God your-God in-falsehood, for not-he-declares-clean God to-him-who swears his-name in-falsehood.
sentences.i: Do not swear falsely by the name of the Lord your God, for the Lord will not declare clean the one who swears falsely by his name.
sentences.n: Exodus 20:7. ኢትምሐል is the 2ms jussive of ምሐለ 'swear'; the thing sworn by stands in the accusative (ስመ 'name', construct before እግዚኣብሔር). በሐሰት is በ- 'in' + ሐሰት 'falsehood', i.e. 'falsely'. ኢያነጽሕ is the 3ms imperfect of አንጽሐ, the causative of ነጽሐ 'be clean' ('make clean, acquit'). ለዘ ይምሕል 'to him who swears' is ለ- + ዘ + the 3ms imperfect; the printed text spaces ለዘ from its verb. ስሞ is ስም + the object-case 3ms suffix, 'his name'.

sentences.t: ወዕቀብ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ሰንበት ፡ ከመ ፡ ትቀድሳ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዘ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፤
sentences.l: And-keep (you) day-of sabbath so-that you-sanctify-it as commanded God your-God;
sentences.i: Keep the Sabbath day, that you may make it holy, as the Lord your God commanded;
sentences.n: Exodus 20:8. ዕቀብ is the 2ms imperative of ዐቀበ 'keep' (see sentence 1). ዕለተ ሰንበት is a construct chain, 'day-of Sabbath'. ከመ ትቀድሳ is ከመ + the 2ms subjunctive of ቀደሰ 'sanctify, make holy' + -ሃ 'it' (feminine, agreeing with ዕለት 'day'). በከመ is 'in the way that, as'; አዘዘ is the 3ms perfect of the verb of the first sentence.

sentences.t: ሰዱሰ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ትገብር ፡ ግብረከ ፡ ወበሳብዕት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ሰንበቱ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ኢትግበር ፡ ባቲ ፡ ግብረ ፡ ቅኔ ፡ ኢአንተ ፡ ወኢወልድከ ፡ ወኢወለትከ ፡ ወኢገብርከ ፡ ወኢአድግከ ፡ ወኢኵሉ ፡ እንስሳከ ፡ ወኢፈላሲ ፡ ዘይነብር ፡ ኀቤከ ፤
sentences.l: Six(?) days you-do your-work, and-on-seventh day, his-sabbath, of-God your-God, not-you-do on-it work-of service: not you and-not your-son and-not your-daughter and-not your-servant and-not your-donkey and-not any your-beast and-not stranger who-dwells with-you;
sentences.i: You shall do your work for six days, and on the seventh day, which is the Sabbath of the Lord your God, you shall do no work of service on it: neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your servant, nor your donkey, nor any of your animals, nor the stranger who lives with you;
sentences.n: Exodus 20:9-10. ሰዱሰ is the accusative of ሰዱስ, which I read as 'six' before መዋዕለ 'days' (the plural of ዕለት); strictly ሰዱስ is the ordinal 'sixth' (the cardinal is ስድስቱ), so the text uses it loosely (?), and the same word appears below in በሰዱስ መዋዕል 'in six days'. ትገብር ግብረከ is the 2ms imperfect of ገብረ 'do' with its own noun ግብር 'work' in the accusative (+ -ከ): a command in imperfect form. ሳብዕት is the feminine ordinal 'seventh', agreeing with ዕለት. ሰንበቱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'his Sabbath, God's' (-ቱ is the 3ms suffix 'his' on ሰንበት; a suffix meaning 'its' for the feminine day would be -ሃ, so the 'his' is God, named in the ለ- phrase) shows the pattern of suffix first, owner afterwards in ለ- (noted in chapter 41). ባቲ is በ- 'in' + -ቲ 'her, it' (feminine, the day); ግብረ ቅኔ is a construct chain 'work-of service' (ቅኔ as in sentence 2). ኢአንተ ... ወኢ... lists the persons barred, 'not you, and not ...': ገብር is a male servant, አድግ 'donkey', እንስሳ 'beast, livestock' (collective), ፈላሲ 'stranger, sojourner' (from ፈለሰ 'migrate'), ዘይነብር ኀቤከ 'who dwells with you' (ኀበ 'at, with' + -ከ). There is no female servant in this list.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ በሰዱስ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ገብረ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ሰማየ ፡ ወምድረ ፡ ወባሕረ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ዘውስቴታ ፡ ወአዕረፈ ፡ አመ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ሳብዕት ፡ ወበበይነዝ ፡ ባረካ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለሳብዕት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ወአጽደቃ ።
sentences.l: For in-six days made God heaven and-earth and-sea and-all that-in-it, and-rested on day-of seventh; and-on-account-of-this blessed-it God to-the-seventh day and-made-it-righteous.
sentences.i: For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth and the sea and all that is in it, and rested on the seventh day. Therefore the Lord blessed the seventh day and declared it righteous.
sentences.n: Exodus 20:11 (cf. Genesis 2:2-3). ገብረ is the 3ms perfect of ገብረ 'make'; ሰማየ ወምድረ ወባሕረ are accusatives (-ä) of 'heaven, earth, sea'. ዘውስቴታ is ዘ + ውስቴታ, 'what is in it' (ውስተ 'in' with the feminine singular suffix -ታ, pointing back to the nearest noun, 'sea' or 'earth' (?)). ወአዕረፈ is 'and rested' (አዕረፈ, 3ms perfect, intransitive in Geʿez). አመ ዕለተ ሳብዕት 'on the day, the seventh' (አመ 'on, at the time of'). ወበበይነዝ is በበይነ 'on account of' + ዝ 'this', written together: 'therefore'. ባረካ is the 3ms perfect of ባረከ 'bless' + -ሃ 'it' (feminine); the object is then repeated as ለሳብዕት ዕለት, the same suffix-then-ለ habit as above. ወአጽደቃ is አጽደቀ, the causative of ጸደቀ 'be righteous, be just', + -ሃ: literally 'declared it righteous'. The Exodus parallel would lead one to expect 'hallowed', but the Geʿez word is አጽደቀ 'make/declare righteous', not the usual verb for 'make holy' (ቀደሰ, used in sentence 8), so I render what is written (?).

sentences.t: አክብር ፡ አባከ ፡ ወእምከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይኩንከ ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ ብዙኀ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ትረክብ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ዘወሀበከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ።
sentences.l: Honor your-father and-your-mother, so-that it-be-to-you righteousness much, day(s, acc.) you-find in-within land which-gave-you God your-God.
sentences.i: Honor your father and your mother, so that much righteousness may be yours, and you may find days in the land which the Lord your God gave you.
sentences.n: Exodus 20:12. አክብር is the 2ms imperative of አክበረ 'honor', the causative of ከበረ 'be heavy, honored' (root of ክብር 'glory'). አባከ is the accusative of አብ 'father' + -ከ. ይኩንከ is the 3ms subjunctive of ኮነ 'be' + -ከ 'to you': 'that there be to you'. This is the idiom the earlier sentence 3 lacks. The clause is ambiguous (?): I read ብዙኀ 'much' with ጽድቀ (noun then adjective, the normal order), 'much righteousness' meaning well-being, and ዕለተ ትረክብ as 'you will find days', probably a long life (?); ብዙኀ ዕለተ 'many days' is the other possibility. The i keeps the literal 'find days'. ትረክብ is the 2ms imperfect of ረከበ 'find'. በውስተ is two prepositions together, በ- + ውስተ 'in the midst of'. ዘወሀበከ is ዘ + ወሀበ 'gave' + -ከ 'you'; the ዘ stands for 'which' and refers to the land.

sentences.t: ኢትሖር ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ ብእሲ ።
sentences.l: Not-you-go (to) wife-of man.
sentences.i: Do not go in to a man's wife.
sentences.n: The commandments now come in short bursts, one verb each. ኢትሖር is the 2ms jussive of ሖረ 'go'; with the wife as a direct accusative (not the usual ኀበ 'to', which appears at the end of the chapter) I take it as a euphemism for sexual relations (?), so this is the prohibition of adultery (Exodus 20). ብእሲተ ብእሲ is a construct chain, 'wife-of a man'. The order here differs from the order of Exodus 20.

sentences.t: ኢትቅትል ፡ ነፍሰ ።
sentences.l: Not-you-kill a-soul.
sentences.i: Do not kill a person.
sentences.n: ኢትቅትል is the 2ms jussive of ቀተለ 'kill'. ነፍሰ is the accusative of ነፍስ 'soul, life, person', so literally 'do not kill a person'.

sentences.t: ኢትዘሙ ።
sentences.l: Not-you-fornicate.
sentences.i: Do not commit fornication.
sentences.n: ኢትዘሙ looks like the 2ms jussive of ዘመወ 'commit fornication, whore', a verb of sexual sin (adultery or fornication) (?); the exact vowel pattern of this verb type is not one I can vouch for. It stands without object.

sentences.t: ኢትስርቅ ።
sentences.l: Not-you-steal.
sentences.i: Do not steal.
sentences.n: ኢትስርቅ is the 2ms jussive of ሰረቀ 'steal'.

sentences.t: ስምዐ ፡ በሐሰት ፡ ኢትስማዕ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ቢጽከ ።
sentences.l: Testimony in-falsehood not-you-hear against your-fellow.
sentences.i: Do not listen to false testimony against your neighbor.
sentences.n: ስምዐ is the accusative of ስምዕ 'testimony, witness' and በሐሰት 'in falsehood' makes it false testimony. The verb ኢትስማዕ is, as written, the 2ms jussive of ሰምዐ 'hear' (the same verb as ስምዑ in sentence 1), so the literal sense is 'do not hear a false testimony', 'do not listen to'. It is probably meant as 'do not give testimony' (a slip for a causative or ተ-stem, e.g. አስምዐ) (?), which would be the usual commandment; but the l and i render the word as written. ቢጽ is 'companion, fellow', here 'neighbor'; ላዕለ 'against, upon'.

sentences.t: ወኢትፍትው ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ ካልእከ ፡ ኢቤቶ ፡ ወኢገራህቶ ፡ ወኢገብሮ ፡ ወኢአመቶ ፡ ወኢላህሞ ፡ ወኢብዕራዮ ፡ ወኢአድጎ ፡ ወኢእምኵሉ ፡ እንስሳሁ ፡ ዘአጥረየ ፡ አጥርዮ ፡ ካልእከ ፤
sentences.l: And-not-you-desire wife-of your-other, not his-house and-not his-field and-not his-servant and-not his-maidservant and-not his-cow(?) and-not his-ox(?) and-not his-donkey and-not from-all his-beast, what-he-acquired, his-acquisition(?), your-other;
sentences.i: And do not covet the wife of your neighbor, nor his house, nor his field, nor his servant, nor his maidservant, nor his cow, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor any of his animals, nor whatever your neighbor has acquired;
sentences.n: Exodus 20:17. ትፍትው is the 2ms jussive of ፈተወ 'desire, long for, covet'. ካልእ means 'second, other' and ካልእከ 'your other', 'your fellow, neighbor'. The list is a run of nouns each with the suffix -ሁ 'his' (spelled -o after a consonant, here -ቶ, -ሮ, -ሞ, -ዮ, -ጎ): ቤቶ 'his house', ገራህቶ 'his field' (ገራህት), ገብሮ 'his servant', አመቶ 'his maidservant' (አመት), ላህሞ and ብዕራዮ two words for cattle, ላህም 'cow, ox' and ብዕራይ 'ox', which I cannot tell apart here (?); l and i keep both, አድጎ 'his donkey'. Each item has its own ኢ- 'not'. ወኢእምኵሉ እንስሳሁ 'nor from all his beasts' is a partitive (እም 'from, of'). The last words ዘአጥረየ አጥርዮ are uncertain (?): ዘአጥረየ would be 'what he acquired' (a verb ጠረየ 'acquire, gain property', as I understand it) and አጥርዮ 'his acquisition' repeats it; the whole probably stands for Exodus's closing 'anything that is your neighbor's'.

sentences.t: ዝነገር ፡ ዘነገረ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ሕጎ ፡ ወሥርዐቶ ፡ ወለእለኒ ፡ ይኤብሱ ፡ ገሥጾሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይጽንዑ ፡ ውስተስሒት ፡ ወይትዐገሱ ፡ እምርኵስ ፡ ዘኢሠምረ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: This-matter which-spoke God, his-law and-his-ordinance; and-as-for-those-who-also are-stubborn(?), rebuke-them, so-that not they-persist in-error and-they-hold-back from-uncleanness which-not-was-pleased God;
sentences.i: This is the matter that God spoke, his law and his ordinance. And as for those who are stubborn, rebuke them, so that they do not persist in error and so that they hold back from the uncleanness with which God is displeased;
sentences.n: Here the speech turns to Leviticus 18. ዝነገር is ዝ 'this' and ነገር 'matter, word' written together. ዘነገረ is ዘ + ነገረ 'spoke' (3ms perfect); ሕጎ and ሥርዐቶ are 'his law' and 'his ordinance' (ሕግ, ሥርዓት + -ሁ), in apposition to the matter. ወለእለኒ is ወ- + ለእለ 'to/for those who' + the enclitic -ኒ 'also, as for'. ይኤብሱ is uncertain (?): a 3mp imperfect whose root I cannot fix; from the context ('rebuke them, that they not persist') it is a verb of stubbornness or wrongdoing. ገሥጾሙ is the 2ms imperative of ገሠጸ 'rebuke, admonish' + -ሙ 'them'; it is spelled with 1st-order ገ where ግ is expected, as in chapter 41, so the vowels here are the edition's. ከመ ኢይጽንዑ is ከመ + ኢ + the 3mp subjunctive of ጸንዐ 'be firm, persist'. ውስተስሒት is ውስተ 'into' + ስሒት 'error' written together (ስሒት from ሰሀተ 'err, go astray'); the same run-together is common in this text. ይትዐገሱ is the 3mp imperfect of the reflexive of a verb of restraint (ዐገሠ), 'hold back, forbear'. እምርኵስ 'from uncleanness' (ርኵስ). ዘኢሠምረ is ዘ + ኢ + ሠምረ 'was pleased with', i.e. 'which he did not approve'.

sentences.t: ወዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ነገር ፡ ዘኢሠምረ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወርቱዕ ፡ ይትገሐሱ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ይከውኖ ፡ ዘመዱ ፡ ኢይባእ ፡ ይክሥት ፡ ኀፍረቶ ፤
sentences.l: And-this he matter which-not-was-pleased God, and-fitting they-keep-away from-it man man, to-where it-is-to-him his-kinsman: not let-him-enter, uncover his-nakedness;
sentences.i: And this is the matter with which God is displeased, and it is right that every man keep away from it: let him not go in to one who is his kin, to uncover his nakedness;
sentences.n: ወዝንቱ ውእቱ ነገር 'and this it (is) matter' is the plain copula with ውእቱ. ርቱዕ means 'upright, fitting', and ወርቱዕ 'and (it is) fitting' is followed by a plain imperfect, ይትገሐሱ, 3mp of ተገሐሰ 'withdraw, keep away from' (the verb's form is plural though ብእሲ ብእሲ is singular, 'each man', a repeated word for 'every'). እምኔሁ 'from it'. ኀበ ይከውኖ ዘመዱ is ኀበ 'to, where' + ይከውኖ, 3ms imperfect of ኮነ + -ሁ 'to him', + ዘመዱ 'his kinsman' (ዘመድ + -ሁ), so 'to where there is to him a kinsman', 'to one who is his kin' (?, loosely). ኢይባእ is the 3ms jussive of ቦአ 'enter, go in', and ይክሥት is the 3ms subjunctive of ከሠተ 'uncover, reveal' with no ከመ (a purpose clause by juxtaposition). ኀፍረቶ is ኀፍረት 'shame, nakedness' + -ሁ; I render ኀፍረት 'nakedness' in this idiom throughout, and the suffix is 'his' as written. This is the idiom for the chapter: 'to uncover the nakedness of' a woman means to have sexual relations with her (Leviticus 18:6).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ አነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ።
sentences.l: For I he God your-God.
sentences.i: For I am the Lord your God.
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:2, the refrain that frames the Levitical chapter. አምላክክሙ is አምላክ + -ክሙ 'your (2mp)', plural, where the suffix before was singular -ከ: the speaker is again addressing the whole people.

sentences.t: ኀፍረተ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ወእምከ ፡ ኢትክሥት ፡ እስመ ፡ እምከ ፡ ይእቲ ፤
sentences.l: Nakedness-of your-father and-your-mother not-you-uncover, for your-mother she.
sentences.i: Do not uncover the nakedness of your father and your mother, for she is your mother.
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:7. A pattern repeated over the next sentences: ኀፍረተ X ኢትክሥት እስመ Y ይእቲ, 'the nakedness of X do not uncover, for she is Y'. ኀፍረተ is the construct (and accusative) of ኀፍረት 'shame, pudenda' (?), which I render 'nakedness' in this idiom; ኢትክሥት is the 2ms jussive of ከሠተ 'uncover'; ይእቲ is the feminine pronoun 'she (is)'. The sentence names father and mother together but gives only the mother as the reason, 'for she is your mother'.

sentences.t: ኢትክሥት ፡ ኀፍረተ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ አቡከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኀፍረተ ፡ እምከ ፡ ይእቲ ፤
sentences.l: Not-you-uncover nakedness-of wife-of your-father, for nakedness-of your-mother she.
sentences.i: Do not uncover the nakedness of your father's wife, for it is your mother's nakedness.
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:8. ብእሲተ አቡከ is a second-level chain, 'wife-of your-father'. Leviticus gives 'it is your father's nakedness' as the reason; the text here has 'your mother's', which looks like a slip or a different reading (?); ይእቲ is the feminine pronoun 'she/it', which could point to the wife or to the nakedness (?). l and i keep the Geʿez as written ('your mother's').

sentences.t: ኀፍረተ ፡ እኅትከ ፡ እንተ ፡ እምነ ፡ አቡከ ፡ አው ፡ እንተ ፡ እምነ ፡ እምከ ፡ ኢትክሥት ፤
sentences.l: Nakedness-of your-sister who from your-father or who from your-mother not-you-uncover;
sentences.i: Do not uncover the nakedness of your sister, whether she is from your father or from your mother;
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:9. እኅትከ 'your sister' (እኅት + -ከ). እንተ is the feminine relative 'who (f.)', parallel to ዘ, with እምነ 'from' (አቡከ, እምከ): 'she who is from your father'. አው 'or'.

sentences.t: እመኒ ፡ እንተ ፡ እምነ ፡ አፍአ ፡ ተወልደት ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወእመኒ ፡ እንተ ፡ እምአዝማዲከ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ኢትክሥት ፡ ኀፍረታ ፤
sentences.l: Whether she-who from outside was-born to-him, and-whether she-who from-your-kinsfolk she, not-you-uncover her-nakedness;
sentences.i: Whether she was born to him from outside, or whether she is one of your kinsfolk, do not uncover her nakedness;
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:9, second half. እመኒ is እመ 'if' + -ኒ, 'even if, whether', paired ወእመኒ 'or whether'. ተወልደት is the 3fs perfect of ተወልደ 'be born' (passive). ሎቱ 'to him' I take as the father (?). እምነ አፍአ is 'from outside', which I leave unexplained (?); እምአዝማዲከ is እም + አዝማድ (plural of ዘመድ 'kinsman') + -ከ. ኢትክሥት ኀፍረታ is the refrain again, with the pronoun suffix -ሃ 'her'.

sentences.t: ኀፍረተ ፡ ወለተ ፡ ወልድከ ፡ ኢትክሥት ፡ አው ፡ ኀፍረተ ፡ ወለተ ፡ ወለትከ ፡ ኢትክሥት ፡ እስመ ፡ ኀፍረትከ ፡ ይእቲ ፤
sentences.l: Nakedness-of daughter-of your-son not-you-uncover, or nakedness-of daughter-of your-daughter not-you-uncover, for your-nakedness she;
sentences.i: Do not uncover the nakedness of your son's daughter or the nakedness of your daughter's daughter, for she is your own nakedness;
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:10. ወለተ ወልድከ 'daughter-of your-son' and ወለተ ወለትከ 'daughter-of your-daughter' are construct chains (ወለት 'daughter', ወልድ 'son'). ኀፍረትከ ይእቲ 'she is your nakedness' means she is of your own flesh.

sentences.t: ኀፍረተ ፡ ወለተ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ኢትክሥት ፡ እስመ ፡ እኅትከ ፡ ወለተ ፡ እምከ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ወኢትክሥት ፡ ኀፍረታ ፤
sentences.l: Nakedness-of daughter-of wife-of your-father not-you-uncover, for your-sister, daughter-of your-mother, she, and-not-you-uncover her-nakedness;
sentences.i: Do not uncover the nakedness of the daughter of your father's wife, for she is your sister, your mother's daughter, and do not uncover her nakedness;
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:11. Three nouns in a chain, ወለተ ብእሲተ አቡከ, 'daughter-of wife-of your-father'. The reason given, 'your sister, the daughter of your mother', is as written; Leviticus has 'begotten of your father', so 'of your mother' may be a simplification or a slip (?).

sentences.t: ኀፍረተ ፡ እኅተ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ኢትክሥት ፡ እስመ ፡ ቤተ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ይእቲ ፤
sentences.l: Nakedness-of sister-of your-father not-you-uncover, for house-of your-father she.
sentences.i: Do not uncover the nakedness of your father's sister, for she is of your father's house.
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:12. እኅተ አቡከ is 'sister-of your-father' (አብ and እኅት, the latter with its construct form እኅተ). ቤተ አቡከ ይእቲ, 'she is house-of your-father', uses ቤት 'house' for the family line.

sentences.t: ኀፍረተ ፡ እኅተ ፡ እምከ ፡ ኢትክሥት ፡ እስመ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እምከ ፡ ይእቲ ፤
sentences.l: Nakedness-of sister-of your-mother not-you-uncover, for house-of your-mother she.
sentences.i: Do not uncover the nakedness of your mother's sister, for she is of your mother's house.
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:13, on the pattern of the last sentence.

sentences.t: ኀፍረተ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ለአቡከ ፡ ኢትክሥት ፡ እስመ ፡ ዘመድከ ፡ ይእቲ ፤
sentences.l: Nakedness-of wife-of his-brother, to-your-father, not-you-uncover, for your-kinswoman she.
sentences.i: Do not uncover the nakedness of the wife of your father's brother, for she is your kinswoman.
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:14. እኁሁ ለአቡከ 'his brother, to your father' (እኁ 'brother' + -ሁ, then the owner with ለ-) is the suffix-then-ለ habit; it means 'your father's brother'. ዘመድከ is 'your kinsman/kinswoman' (ዘመድ + -ከ), here a woman.

sentences.t: ኀፍረተ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ ወልድከ ፡ ኢትክሥት ፡ እስመ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ ወልድከ ፡ ይእቲ ፤
sentences.l: Nakedness-of wife-of your-son not-you-uncover, for wife-of your-son she.
sentences.i: Do not uncover the nakedness of your son's wife, for she is your son's wife.
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:15, the daughter-in-law. The reason repeats the prohibited relation.

sentences.t: ኀፍረተ ፡ ወለትከ ፡ ወብእሲተ ፡ ወልደ ፡ እኁከ ፡ ኢትክሥት ፡ እስመ ፡ ኀፍረትከ ፡ ውእቱ ፤
sentences.l: Nakedness-of your-daughter and-of-wife-of son-of your-brother not-you-uncover, for your-nakedness it.
sentences.i: Do not uncover the nakedness of your daughter, or of the wife of your brother's son, for it is your own nakedness;
sentences.n: As written this forbids two women, your daughter and the wife of your brother's son, and does not follow Leviticus 18 closely: ኀፍረተ ወለትከ 'nakedness-of your-daughter' and then ወብእሲተ ወልደ እኁከ, 'and wife-of son-of your-brother' with the second ብእሲተ also in the accusative. The closing ውእቱ is masculine where ይእቲ is expected for ኀፍረት; I take it as loose agreement (?).

sentences.t: ኀፍረተ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ እኁከ ፡ ኢትክሥት ፡ እስመ ፡ ኀፍረተ ፡ እኁከ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ አምጣነ ፡ ሀሎ ፡ ሕያው ፡ እኁከ ፤
sentences.l: Nakedness-of wife-of your-brother not-you-uncover, for nakedness-of your-brother she, as-long-as is living your-brother;
sentences.i: Do not uncover the nakedness of your brother's wife, for it is your brother's nakedness, as long as your brother is alive;
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:16. አምጣነ 'as long as, in so far as', ሀሎ (3ms perfect, used as present 'is, exists') and ሕያው 'living'. The qualification 'as long as your brother lives' implies the case after his death is another matter (compare the levirate law, Deuteronomy 25:5-10) (?), which the text does not state.

sentences.t: ኀፍረተ ፡ ብእሲት ፡ ምስለ ፡ ወለታ ፡ ኢትክሥት ፡ ወኢዘወለተ ፡ ወልዳ ፡ ወኢዘወለተ ፡ ወለታ ፡ ኢትግበር ፡ ከመ ፡ ትክሥት ፡ ኀፍረቶን ፡ ቤትከ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወኀጢአት ፡ ውእቱ ፤
sentences.l: Nakedness-of a-woman with her-daughter not-you-uncover, and-not that-of daughter-of her-son and-not that-of daughter-of her-daughter not-you-do so-that you-uncover their-nakedness: your-house it, and-sin it;
sentences.i: Do not uncover the nakedness of a woman together with her daughter, and do not do so with her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter, so as to uncover their nakedness: it is your house, and it is sin;
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:17. ምስለ 'with'; ወለታ is ወለት + -ሃ 'her daughter'; ወልዳ 'her son'. ዘወለተ ወልዳ is ዘ 'that of' + the chain ወለተ ወልዳ, 'that (nakedness) of her son's daughter'. ኢትግበር ከመ ትክሥት is 'do not do, so as to uncover' (ከመ + 2ms subjunctive). ኀፍረቶን has -ቶን 'their (f.)' (ኀፍረት + the feminine plural suffix). ቤትከ is 'your house', here 'your own family, your kin' (see ቤተ አቡከ above); the pronoun ውእቱ is again masculine for a feminine group.

sentences.t: ወብእሲተ ፡ ምስለ ፡ እኅታ ፡ ኢታውስብ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታስተቃንዖን ፡ ወከመ ፡ ትክሥትኀፍረቶን ፡ ለዛቲኒ ፡ ወዘእንታክቲኒ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ዓዲሃ ፡ ቀዳሚት ፡ ሕያውት ፡ ይእቲ ፤
sentences.l: And-a-woman with her-sister not-you-marry, so-that you-make-them-rivals(?) and-so-that you-uncover-their-nakedness(?), for-this-one-also and-of-that-one-also, while still-she the-first living she;
sentences.i: And do not marry a woman together with her sister, so as to make rivals of them and to uncover their nakedness, the one and the other, while the first is still alive;
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:18. ኢታውስብ is the 2ms jussive of አውሰበ 'take a wife, marry'. ታስተቃንዖን is uncertain (?): it looks like a 2ms subjunctive (ታ- ... ከመ) of a causative-reflexive stem of ቀነአ 'be jealous' (with ዐ written for አ), + -ን 'them (f.)', i.e. 'make them jealous rivals'. ወከመ ትክሥትኀፍረቶን is run together for ወከመ ትክሥት ኀፍረቶን, 'and so that you uncover their nakedness'. ለዛቲኒ ወዘእንታክቲኒ is ለዛቲ 'for this one (f.)' + -ኒ 'also' and ወዘእንታክቲኒ 'and of that one (f.) also', with ዘ- an unclear 'of' (?). እንዘ 'while', ዓዲሃ 'still she' (ዓዲ + -ሃ), ቀዳሚት 'the first (f.)', ሕያውት 'living (f.)'.

sentences.t: ወኀበ ፡ ብእሲት ፡ ትክት ፡ ኢትባእ ፡ እንበለ ፡ ትንጻሕ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትክሥት ፡ ኀፍረታ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ዓዲ ፡ ርኵስት ፡ ይእቲ ፤
sentences.l: And to a-woman ትክት(?) not-you-go-in before she-is-clean, so-that you-uncover her-nakedness while still unclean she;
sentences.i: And do not go in to a woman in her sickness(?), until she is clean, so as to uncover her nakedness while she is still unclean;
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:19, the woman in menstrual impurity. ትክት is uncertain (?): I take it as a word for a woman's impurity or sickness from context alone ('until she is clean ... while still unclean'). ኢትባእ ኀበ 'do not go in to' is the 2ms jussive of ቦአ + ኀበ; እንበለ ትንጻሕ is እንበለ 'before, unless' + the 3fs subjunctive of ነጽሐ 'be clean'. ርኵስት is the feminine of ርኩስ 'unclean'. The remaining clause is the refrain with ከመ.

sentences.t: ወኢትባእ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ ካልእከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትስክብ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወኢትዝራእ ፡ ዘርእከ ፡ ውስቴታ ፤
sentences.l: And-not-you-go-in to wife-of your-other so-that you-lie with-her, and-not-you-sow your-seed in-her;
sentences.i: And do not go in to your neighbor's wife to lie with her, and do not sow your seed in her;
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:20. ከመ ትስክብ is ከመ + the 2ms subjunctive of ሰከበ 'lie down, lie with'; ምስሌሃ is ምስለ 'with' + -ሃ. ኢትዝራእ is the 2ms jussive of ዘርአ 'sow', ዘርእከ 'your seed'. ካልእከ as in sentence 17.

sentences.t: ወኢታስተፃምድ ፡ ኀበ ፡ መልአከ ፡ ውሉድከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢታርኵስ ፡ ስሞ ፡ ለቅዱስ ፡ ስመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: And-not-you-hand-over(?) to angel-of your-children so-that not you-defile his-name, to-the-Holy-One, name-of God;
sentences.i: And do not hand over(?) to the angel of your children, so as not to defile the name of the Holy One, the name of the Lord;
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:21, traditionally read as the ban on giving offspring to Molech (an inference from the parallel, not from these words). ኢታስተፃምድ is uncertain (?): 2ms jussive of a causative-reflexive of ፀመደ/ተፃመደ 'be yoked, joined', so 'join, hand over'. መልአከ ውሉድከ is the chain 'angel-of your-children'; መልአክ is 'angel, messenger', which does not obviously name Molech, so the reading rests on the parallel verse (?). ኢታርኵስ is the 2ms subjunctive of አርኰሰ 'defile'. ስሞ ለቅዱስ is 'his name, of the Holy One' (suffix then ለ-), and ስመ እግዚኣብሔር 'name-of the Lord' makes it explicit.

sentences.t: ወምስለ ፡ ተባዕት ፡ ኢትስክብ ፡ ከመ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አንስት ፡ እስመ ፡ ርኩስ ፡ ውእቱ ፤
sentences.l: And with a-male not-you-lie as with women, for unclean he.
sentences.i: And do not lie with a male as with women, for it is unclean.
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:22. ተባዕት 'male'; አንስት is the plural of ብእሲት 'woman' (sentence 12), the broken plural 'women'. ርኩስ ውእቱ 'unclean it (is)' with the masculine adjective.

sentences.t: ወኢትሖር ፡ ኀበ ፡ እንስሳ ፡ ወኢትስክብ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታ ፡ ውፅእ ፡ ዘርአከ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትርኰስ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ወብእሲትኒ ፡ ኢትሖር ፡ ኀበ ፡ እንስሳ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይስክባ ፡ እስመ ፡ ርኵስ ፡ ውእቱ ።
sentences.l: And-not-you-go to a-beast and-not-you-lie so-that you-emit your-seed upon-it so-that not you-be-defiled by-it; and-a-woman-also not-she-go to a-beast so-that it-lie-with-her, for unclean it.
sentences.i: And do not go to a beast, and do not lie so as to emit your seed upon it, that you not be defiled by it; and a woman also must not go to a beast so that it lies with her, for it is unclean.
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:23. The printed ታ ፡ ውፅእ is ታውፅእ, the 2ms subjunctive of አውፅአ 'bring out, emit' (the wordspace is the edition's, and the build treats it as two words) (?). ዘርአከ is 'your seed' (accusative ዘርአ + -ከ), where ዘርእከ above has the 6th-order vowel. ላዕሌሁ 'upon it'. ኢትርኰስ is the 2ms subjunctive of ረኰሰ 'be defiled' (G stem, the verb of ረኵሱ in the next sentence; the passive of አርኰሰ would be ትትርኰስ); ቦቱ 'in/by it'. ወብእሲትኒ is ብእሲት + -ኒ 'also'. ከመ ይስክባ is ከመ + the 3ms subjunctive of ሰከበ + -ሃ 'her': the beast is the subject.

sentences.t: ወኢታርኵሱ ፡ ርእሰክሙ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ እስመ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ረኵሱ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እለ ፡ አነ ፡ አውፃእክዎሙ ፡ እምቅድሜክሙ ፡ ወበዝንቱ ፡ ኢታርኵሱ ፡ ሥጋክሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-not-you-defile yourselves(lit. your-heads) in-all this, for by-it were-defiled nations who I brought-out from-before-you, and-by-this not-you-defile your-flesh;
sentences.i: And do not defile yourselves by all this, for by it the nations whom I brought out from before you were defiled, and by this do not defile your bodies;
sentences.n: Leviticus 18:24. ኢታርኵሱ is the 2mp jussive of አርኰሰ 'defile'; ርእሰክሙ is ርእስ 'head' + -ክሙ, 'yourselves' (the word 'head' does the work of a reflexive). ረኵሱ is the 3mp perfect of ረኰሰ 'be unclean'. አሕዛብ 'nations, peoples'; እለ 'who, whom' (plural), with አውፃእክዎሙ, the 1cs perfect of አውፅአ 'bring out' (as in sentence 2; here it means expel) + -ሙ. እምቅድሜክሙ 'from before you' (እም + ቅድሜ + -ክሙ). ሥጋክሙ 'your flesh', 'your bodies'.

sentences.t: ወቀድሱ ፡ ነፍሰክሙ ፡ ወሥጋክሙ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወያፈቅሮሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይቄድሱ ፡ ነፍሶሙ ፡ ወሥጋሆሙ ፡ ሎቱ ፤
sentences.l: And-sanctify (you-pl) your-souls and-your-flesh to-God, for holy he, and-he-loves-them, those who sanctify their-souls and-their-flesh to-him;
sentences.i: And sanctify your souls and your bodies to God, for he is holy, and he loves those who sanctify their souls and their bodies to him;
sentences.n: ቀድሱ is the 2mp imperative of ቀደሰ 'sanctify' (the same verb as in sentence 8); ነፍሰክሙ ወሥጋክሙ 'your souls and your flesh'. ቅዱስ 'holy'. ያፈቅሮሙ ለእለ ይቄድሱ is 'he loves them, those who sanctify', the suffix-then-ለ habit again (ያፈቅሮሙ is አፍቀረ + -ሙ). ይቄድሱ is a 3mp imperfect of ቀደሰ. ሎቱ 'to him' ends the sentence.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ወግሩም ፡ ወልዑል ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወመሓሪ ፡ ወመስተሣህል ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወሎቱ ፡ ይደሉ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ፡ አሜን ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: For holy and-awesome and-exalted he, and-merciful and-compassionate he, and-to-him it-is-fitting praise for-age-of age. Amen. ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.i: For he is holy, awesome, and exalted; he is merciful and compassionate; and to him praise is due for ever and ever. Amen.
sentences.n: The closing doxology. ግሩም 'awesome, to be feared' and ልዑል 'exalted'; መሓሪ is an active participle, 'one who forgives, merciful', and መስተሣህል 'compassionate'. ይደሉ is the 3ms imperfect of ደለወ 'be fitting, be due', so 'it is fitting for him: praise'. ለዓለመ ዓለም is 'for the age of age', the formula for 'forever'. The run of ፨ at the end is the edition's closing mark, not words.
